step2_context.domain: Developer Tooling — Software Supply Chain Security
step2_context.primary_function: CLI-based Software Bill of Materials engine that scans a single codebase and produces machine-readable dependency and vulnerability inventory, CI/CD-ready
recommended_bdd_focus: Happy path: scan Python repo and export CycloneDX JSON
Happy path: scan JS/TS repo and export SPDX JSON
Single repository constraint: reject invocation with multiple repos
Single environment constraint: scope scan to specified environment
Dependency completeness: direct + transitive captured with name, version, supplier
PURL/CPE identifier presence on each dependency
CVSS severity classification: High, Medium, Low assigned per vulnerability
Remediation enrichment: at least one of (recommendation, advisory link) per vulnerability
VEX filtering: suppressed vulnerabilities not included in output (or flagged)
No live NVD API call at scan time: all lookups from local cache only
NVD sync: daily schedule trigger populates local cache
NVD sync: on-demand refresh command populates local cache
Output format schema compliance: SPDX and CycloneDX JSON pass spec validation
CI/CD gate: non-zero exit code on scan error
risk_scenarios: NVD cache stale or empty at scan time: system should warn or error, not silently produce zero vulnerabilities
Unsupported language repository scanned: graceful error, not silent empty output
Dependency deduplication: Trivy and Syft report same dependency — output contains it exactly once
VEX filtering: VEX-suppressed vulnerability does not appear as unfiltered in output
CVSS threshold boundary: score at exact boundary between severity bands
success_criteria: All direct and transitive dependencies captured with name, version, supplier
SPDX and CycloneDX JSON export passes format schema validation
Every vulnerability has CVSS severity and at least one enrichment field
Zero live NVD API calls during scan (verified by network isolation test)
CLI exits with success code on clean scan, non-zero on error

bdd_focus_guidance.from_engines: CVSS Severity Classifier — test each severity band (High/Medium/Low), boundary conditions (note: thresholds require clarification), and missing score handling
bdd_focus_guidance.from_workflows: Scan Workflow — test happy path, error path (invalid repo), and cache-miss path; NVD Sync Workflow — test daily and on-demand triggers
bdd_focus_guidance.from_rules: All 7 business rules have direct BDD scenarios; priority ordering matters for Single Repository + Single Environment constraints
bdd_focus_guidance.from_ambiguities: 2 open clarifications remain: CVSS numeric thresholds (CQ-1), remediation OR logic (CQ-2) — BDD scenarios should use placeholder thresholds pending clarification. CLI framework (CQ-3) is resolved: use Typer.

open_clarifications_for_step2.question: Are standard CVSS v3.1 bands intended? Does the 3-band scheme collapse Critical (>=9.0) into High?
open_clarifications_for_step2.bdd_guidance: Write scenarios using placeholder labels (High/Medium/Low) and note threshold TBD in scenario comments

open_clarifications_for_step2.question: Is at least one of (recommendation, advisory_link) mandatory, or both are independently optional?
open_clarifications_for_step2.bdd_guidance: Write scenarios for both presence and absence; flag this as a gap in scenario metadata
